nodes.label: Full Migration Plan (refraccion)
nodes.description: 10-gate migration plan for the refraccion branch. Architecture: transactional outbox + binlog CDC with durable offsets (ADR-1). Golden rules: NO polling, NO fallback, NO hybrid realtime. Reuse/ownership rule: consolidate before creating. 10 stages: G0 evidence baseline, G0D ownership freeze, G1 ADR decisions, Stage 1 mobile blockers, Stage 2 event contracts, Stage 3 durable ingestion, Stage 4 domain events, Stage 5 Echo recovery, Stage 6 public graph cutover, Stage 7 alert cutover, Stage 8 device projections, Stage 9 mobile hardening, Stage 10 reliability/observability. Current status: Gates 6/7/8 PASS (code), Gate 9 open (auth-transition matrix unexecuted), Gate 10 open (fault injection pending).
nodes.rationale: The single source of truth for the migration strategy. Defines the 10-gate progression, golden rules, ownership consolidation gate, and current status of each gate. Every implementation task maps to a specific gate and stage.
